description: Produce a standard-library Python module that extracts readable text from an HTML fragment, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need the visible text of an HTML fragment with tags removed, script and style contents dropped, entities unescaped and whitespace collapsed, delivered as a module with tests. Do not choose this when you need a parsed DOM, CSS-selector queries, or a faithful browser rendering: the result is a text approximation, not a parsed document. Use a full HTML parser for that. Example requests: Write a Python module that strips HTML tags from a fragment and returns the plain text, with tests. | I need to turn an HTML snippet into readable text, dropping script and style blocks. | Generate an HTML-to-text module and prove it with pytest.
